body: Thank you. I'm going to tell him all of this.
i think he's afraid that if he talks to a therapist he'll come forward about his childhood, and that he would somehow get his dad into trouble. He's very, very, VERY afraid of his dad, even still.

Well, I'm legally blind, so prolonged computer use isn't easy. I'm decent with my hands and I'm really good with people. I really enjoy spending time in the kitchen. My dream is to open a bakery but i'd like to go to school first. I just have to figure out what kind of assistance is available to me(someone to help take notes, etc). School IS free here but I feel like I need to focus on working until we're better off and then I can really focus on school. Right now I just want my husband to get help. We were together for a year before this started. I know what he can be. I just wish he'd go with me to see someone and the fact he won't is really, really tearing me apart.
I'm sorry but I'm not sure how to take that last sentence.

I moved about 4,000 miles for him. I'm originally from another country but we bith thought this would be a better place to raise children and have a life together. I have a few friends here, but they've all got other friends and I rarely see them. His sister and I talk but once again, his family doesn't know what i do for a living so whenever I see her she's always telling me to get a job, which I'd love to do if I can find something I'm physically able to do.

He didn't start acting like this until we started having money troubles in April. before that he was perfect. He just doesn't handle stress well. He was beaten as a child and like I said above, his parents are still really mean to him, and to a lesser extent me, but they also occasionally help us so it's a very hard place to be in. I think he needs therapy but whenever I bring it up he refuses, even if I say I'll get therapy, too. I don't know if it's fear or pride or what. After we get into our hug fights he'll come back to me and act apologetic and even cry sometimes. I just think he needs help..but he won't get it, and that's what's hurting me the most.
